cara: Short thread to finalize the dedicated roadmap delta: we need concrete defaults for spill ordering, autoscale damping, and whether carryover is visible in console for pilots.

vijay: Ops asks: default spill_order = priority, age. Autoscale damping = hysteresis 6m + min_scale_interval 12m. This minimizes thrash.

marta: Commercial: carryover default = off for pilots; show a "Rollover Add-on" toggle in Console mock so sales can demo. Also want an alert when tenant uses >85% of envelope.

vijay: Runtime note: implement shared_pool_spill_rate metric; alert threshold at 0.5%. If breached for 5m, signal ops to prioritize capacity.

cara: Agreed decisions: 1) spill_order = priority,age 2) autoscale defaults = hysteresis 6m, min_interval 12m, up=75% sustained 8m, down=45% sustained 12m 3) carryover = opt-in, hidden for pilot but flaggable 4) telemetry events: reserve.burst_start/end, reserve.spill.

marta: Owners: vijay infra, cara product, marta docs/billing. ETA: 4w to feature-flagged pilot. I'll prep sales one-pager.

infra-bot: note: feature flag `reserve.pilot_h1_2026` created for internal testing.

cara: Thanks all. We'll split config PRs into eng-runtime. Follow-ups in eng-infra and docs channels. :thumbsup:
